== Summary ==
Nathan Reisch of Watertown, South Dakota won his way to Star Wars CCG World Championships with a mammoth win at Gen Con Open. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Nathan Reisch]].
